title: Nutty Flaky Slovakian Rainbow Trout Gratin
description: A Mediterranean‑friendly Slovakian gratin that pairs flaky rainbow trout with a crunchy walnut‑breadcrumb topping and a bright yogurt‑tadka sauce.

ingredients.name: Rainbow trout fillets
ingredients.notes: skin removed, seasoned with salt and pepper

ingredients.name: Lemon zest and juice
ingredients.notes: zest of the peel and 2 tbsp juice

instructions: Season the trout fillets with salt and pepper and place them skin‑side down in a greased baking dish.
In a bowl mix the toasted walnuts, breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan, olive oil, lemon zest, chopped dill, and smoked paprika to form the crust.
Spread the yogurt over each fillet, then sprinkle the nut‑breadcrumb mixture evenly on top.
Reserve the remaining yogurt mixture for the tadka: combine it with mustard seeds, cumin seeds, minced garlic, and chili flakes, stirring until well blended.
Dot the melted butter over the crust and drizzle a few spoonfuls of the yogurt tadka around the fillets.
Bake for 15–18 minutes, until the trout flakes easily and the topping is golden and crisp.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and a sprinkle of fresh dill if desired.
